label: rejected

evidence.V1: Front view reads as a berry bush (lobed mound with berries on the rim), but the silhouette and top view are a generic lumpy blob with dots; only the front/three-quarter read clearly.
evidence.V2: Some hierarchy: one mound, 3-4 merged puffs, 5 berries; the puffs blend into one mass with no distinct medium clusters or leaf-tuft small detail.
evidence.V3: Low, lumpy mound with wobbly lobes reads blobby rather than a confident stylised bush of clear rounded puffs.
evidence.V4: Puffs are soft with no defined lobes or rim highlights, while berries are low-poly faceted balls (octagonal in the top view); inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Puffs close-up shows wobbly crease ridges and puckered folds across the top, a faint grid in the shading, and faceted berry spheres; minor but visible.
evidence.V6: Leaf green plus gold berries (kit gold); disciplined two-colour scheme with good contrast, colourways (autumn, blossom) swap the foliage hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1688 tris vs medium target 2000 (ceiling 4000): under target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material and kit gold accent, but surface is not a clean fused smooth shell (creases, faceted berries); minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line: foliage Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre: correct.

evidence.V1: Front view reads as a low berry bush mound; from top and three-quarter the clover-lobed blob reads more like a pepper or slime, and the silhouette is a soft lump with berry bumps.
evidence.V2: Big mound and small berries are present, but the medium tier (individual puffs) is mushy: lobes melt into each other with no defined clusters.
evidence.V3: Lobes are low and swollen with no lift or crown; proportion reads as a melted dome rather than a confident stylised bush.
evidence.V4: Fused smooth shell is soft everywhere; puff boundaries are vague creases, berries are low-poly with visible faceting, so edge definition is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Studio close-ups show a faint triangle-grid mottling across the puff surfaces and a soft crease seam down the centre where lobes fuse; minor but visible.
evidence.V6: One foliage hue in 2-3 values with gold berries as the single accent; colourways (autumn, blossom) keep the same discipline.
evidence.V7: 1688 tris vs medium target 2000 - under target.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, fused smooth organic shell and gold accent per the Nature spec.
evidence.V9: Studio line: foliage flags (Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box), MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

evidence.V1: Front view reads as a lumpy berry bush, but the silhouette and top view are a generic rounded blob with nubs that could equally be a rock or a cake; readable mainly from the front.
evidence.V2: Big mass with 3-4 broad puffs and small gold berries, but no medium tier (no leaf clusters, sub-puffs or twigs) and puff divisions are shallow creases.
evidence.V3: Squat low dome (3.7 x 3.3 x 2.2 studs) with soft lobes; pleasant but the puffs are too shallow to read as confident stylised foliage clumps.
evidence.V4: Foliage is one blobby fused shell with no defined lobe edges, while the berries are visibly low-poly faceted spheres; edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Faint quad-grid lattice across the foliage and bright streaky crease lines where puffs merge on top (puffs close-up, spruce/blossom colourways); berries show polygon facets.
evidence.V6: Flat close-up shows the foliage is a single green value with no light/dark variation; only the gold berries add contrast, so value structure is weak.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material with gold accent berries fits, but the single-value foliage and visible grid shading fall short of the kit's 2-3 value fused-shell look.
evidence.V9: Foliage profile correct: Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, SmoothPlastic, MeshPart.Color white, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Wobbly crease ridges and puckering across the top of the mound
Faint grid shading on the puffs
Faint triangle-grid mottling across the puff surfaces (Bush_01_close_puffs_studio.png, Bush_01_close_base_studio.png)
Soft crease seam where the central lobes fuse
Quad-grid lattice visible in foliage shading
Bright streaky creases where puffs fuse on the top
top_fixes: Rebuild the mound as 4-6 distinct rounded puffs of varied size with clean smooth unions so the silhouette has clear bumps
Smooth the surface (relax/remesh, weighted normals) to remove creases and puckers
Add segments to the berries and seat them slightly into the foliage; add a lighter top value / darker base value for form
Define distinct rounder puff clusters with clear dips between them and more height in the crown so it reads as a bush, not a melted blob
Smooth the fused shell (weighted normals / extra smoothing pass) to remove the grid mottling and centre crease
Raise berry segment count slightly so they read round in close-up
Deepen and multiply the puffs (5-7 varied-size clumps with clear undercuts) so the silhouette reads as a bush from all angles
Vertex-colour the foliage in 2-3 values (darker underside/creases, lighter tops)
Clean up normals where puffs merge to remove the streaky creases and grid pattern
Add 2-4 segments to the berries or swap to smoother spheres
